name: Csikvánd (Hungary)
description: White field with a row of red triangles along the top edge and a row of blue triangles along the bottom edge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Csikvánd: a white shield with a black ploughshare, a coulter, reeds and a wavy stripe.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
